newsitem.title: USA: Oxford Health chairman gives up CEO title.
newsitem.headline: Oxford Health chairman gives up CEO title.

text.p: Oxford Health Plans Inc said on Tuesday that its founder, Stephen Wiggins, has stepped down as chief executive but will remain the company's chairman.
William Sullivan was promoted to chief executive, the company said in a news release.
Sullivan has filled the chief executive role for the past year, so his formal promotion merely reflects the status quo, Oxford said.
Oxford on Tuesday reported second quarter net income of $0.45 per share, compared with $0.28 for the year-ago period.
